description: This PHP source file defines a client class 'drsClient' for interacting with the AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery Service (DRS). It includes method annotations for various API operations related to disaster recovery, such as creating, deleting, describing, and managing recovery instances and configurations.

classes.name: drsClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient specifically for interacting with AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery Service (DRS). It provides method annotations for the various API operations.

methods.name: associateSourceNetworkStack
methods.description: Associates a source network stack with the disaster recovery setup.

methods.name: createExtendedSourceServer
methods.description: Creates an extended source server in the disaster recovery context.

methods.name: createLaunchConfigurationTemplate
methods.description: Creates a launch configuration template used for recovery purposes.

methods.name: deleteJob
methods.description: Deletes a specified job in the AWS DRS service.
